en: Revenue and Cost per Km Grid
Know what every load really earns before you book it
Know what every load earns before you book it
Load profit before you say yes
rate, km, empty km, fuel, driver pay and tolls give the profit and the profit per km driven before a load is booked
your cost per km and the usual empty km of each lane give the rate that just pays and the margin at the usual rate
asking rate against the offer shows what accepting costs and a counter that still pays
the agreed rate and extras are compared with what the load billed, so over-billing and under-billing show up
Waiting time log with the charge
arrival, departure and free hours give the chargeable hours, the charge and what was left off the invoice
waiting time, unloading fees, extra stops and cancelled load fees with the amount not yet billed and the days it has waited
the dispatch board flags a truck that has two loads on the same day before the driver finds out
weekly checks show where each truck is free, its next pickup and the idle days against your limit
Quote win rate per customer and lane
quotes won, lost on price and the average gap to your asking rate for every customer and lane pair
every load shows which documents are missing and how many days the proof of delivery has been outstanding
fuel price bands with the surcharge per loaded km compared with the formula from your base price
Empty km cost and backhaul search
the cost of every empty run by reason, and a search list for the truck that will be free in a city

Loads with rate, extras, km and profit
One row per load: customer, lane, truck, driver, km, rate and extras; total, revenue per km, profit and the late and margin flags fill in by themselves.
Dispatch board for the next 7 days
One row per load in transit or booked for the coming week; days to pickup and a double-booked truck check fill in so the dispatcher sees clashes before the driver does.
Truck availability checks with idle days
One row per truck at each weekly check: where it is free, when it was last delivered and its next pickup; idle days, the idle flag and the latest check fill in.
The eight trucks with their kind and driver; every load, board and check picks the truck from this list.
The ten trailers with their type and the truck they usually run with; loads pick the trailer from this list.
The owner and seven drivers with the phone used by the message links; loads and boards pick the driver from this list.
Brokers and direct shippers with terms and results
One row per broker or direct shipper with terms and credit limit; loads, revenue, waiting hours and late loads fill in from the Loads sheet.
Lanes with break-even rate and margin at the usual rate
One row per lane with km, usual rate and usual empty km; the break-even rate from your cost per km, the margin at the usual rate and the results from real loads fill in.
Rate quotes to brokers and shippers
One row per quote: the rate offered by the customer against your asking rate; the gap, the quote total, the break-even check and whether to chase an expired quote fill in.
One row per customer and lane pair; quotes, wins, win rate, the average offered rate and the average gap to your asking rate are counted from the Rate Quotes sheet.
Rate confirmations against what was billed
One row per signed rate confirmation: the agreed rate and extras; the total agreed, the difference to what the load billed and a check for extras beyond the agreement fill in.
One row per extra charge with what you paid out and what you bill; the customer, the unbilled flag, the days it has waited and the amount still to bill fill in.
Waiting time at pickups and deliveries
One row per long wait with arrival and departure times; hours on site, the chargeable hours, the charge at your hourly rate and what was left unbilled fill in.
One row per appointment window with the arrival time; the on-time check and the minutes late fill in, and the customer and driver phones are looked up.
Late loads with cause and penalty
One row per late delivery with the cause and any penalty charged by the customer; the customer, lane, penalty per late hour and penalty share of the load fill in.
Empty km with reason and cost
One row per load that had empty km before it, with the reason; the empty share of total km, the cost of the empty km and a check against your empty km target fill in.
Return load search for trucks that will be free
One row per truck that is or will be free in a city: where, when, which way it wants to go, loads offered and the broker asked; days to free and the action fill in.
Load documents and missing proof of delivery
One row per load with the three documents; received on, the missing count, days waiting for proof of delivery and an overall check fill in.
Fuel surcharge schedule by fuel price band
One row per fuel price band with the surcharge per loaded km you ask; the formula surcharge from your base price, the gap to it and the charge on a 500 km load fill in.
One row per week with loads, km, revenue and truck days; revenue per truck day, revenue per loaded km, the empty share and the four-week average fill in.

Hello {driver}, load {load_id} picks up at {origin} on {pickup_date}. Customer reference {customer_ref}. Please confirm you are ready.
Hello {driver}, load {load_id} delivers to {dest} on {delivery_date}. Tell the dispatcher at once if you will be late.
Driver: send the proof of delivery
Hello {driver}, please send the proof of delivery for {load_id} today. {customer} has not received it yet.
Hello {driver}, you are waiting on load {load_id} for {customer}. Note the arrival and departure times and keep the stamped papers. Free hours: {free_hours}.
Hello {driver}, the pickup of load {load_id} changed to {pickup_date} at {origin}. Please confirm.
Hello {driver}, load {load_id} is cancelled. Please stand by, we are finding a new load for truck {truck}.
Hello {driver}, your next load is ready after your delivery in {free_city}. Next pickup {next_pickup}. You have {hours_left} driving hours left this week.
Hello {driver}, before loading {load_id} please check that trailer {trailer} is the right type ({equipment}) and clean, and that the weight is {weight_kg} kg.
Hello, truck {truck} with driver {driver} is assigned to load {load_id}. Pickup {pickup_date} at {origin}.
Hello, the driver is running late on load {load_id} to {dest}. We will send a new arrival time soon and we are sorry for the delay.
Hello, please confirm the rate for load {load_id}: {rate_per_km} per km over {loaded_km} km. Send the signed confirmation before pickup on {pickup_date}.
Customer: our rate on the lane
Hello, our rate on {route} is {avg_asking} per km on average. Please send your next loads on this lane to us.
Hello, load {load_id} waited {wait_hours} hours beyond the free time on {date}. The waiting time charge is {charge}. Please confirm payment.
Hello, load {load_id} was cancelled after the truck was sent. Our fee is {amount}. Please confirm it.
Hello, we paid {cost_paid} for unloading load {load_id} at the dock. The receipt is attached and {amount} will be added to the invoice.
Hello, the proof of delivery for load {load_id} is attached. Please tell us if anything is missing.
Customer: truck free in a city
Hello, truck {truck} is free in {free_city} on {date_free}, heading towards {want_to}. Do you have a load for it?
Hello, we need a new rate for {route}, {loaded_km} km. Our asking rate is {asking_per_km} per km. Please send your offer.
Hello, our driver cannot make the appointment for load {load_id} at {place} on {date}. Can you give us a later window?
Hello, thank you for load {load_id}. Please tell us how we did and send us your next loads.
Owner: load under the target margin
Hello, load {load_id} for {customer} is under your target margin. Revenue per km driven is {rev_driven_km}. Please look at the rate before the next load.
Owner: lane loses money after empty km
Hello, lane {lane_id} ({name}) loses money once empty km count: break-even is {breakeven} per km against a usual rate of {rate_km}.
Hello, load {load_id} needs your approval: the rate of {rate_per_km} per km is under the floor. Customer {customer}, {loaded_km} km.
Hello, the weekly dispatch summary for the week of {week} is ready: {loads} loads, revenue {revenue}, empty km {empty_km}.
Hello, truck {truck} has {idle_days} idle days at the check on {checked_on}. Please decide where it should go.
Hello, load {load_id} for {customer} has no proof of delivery after {days_waiting} days. Please chase it today.
Hello, waiting time of {charge} on load {load_id} is not on the invoice yet. Please add {unbilled} before billing.
Dispatcher: quote waiting for an answer
Hello, quote {quote_id} for {customer} on {route} has expired and is worth a call. Our asking rate was {asking_per_km} per km.
Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.
Customer: {col:rateconf.customer}. Load: {col:rateconf.load_id}. Customer reference: {col:rateconf.customer_ref}. Signed on {col:rateconf.signed_on}.
Agreed rate: {col:rateconf.agreed_rate} per loaded km over {col:rateconf.loaded_km} km, a linehaul of {col:rateconf.agreed_line}. Extras agreed in advance: {col:rateconf.accessorials_agreed}.
Total agreed: {col:rateconf.total_agreed}. Waiting time over the free hours, extra stops and a cancelled load are charged as listed in our rate sheet.
Please sign and return this confirmation before the truck is sent.

Load {col:loads.load_id} for {col:loads.customer}, customer reference {col:loads.customer_ref}. Driver: {col:loads.driver}. Truck {col:loads.truck}, trailer {col:loads.trailer} ({col:loads.equipment}).

Pickup on {col:loads.pickup_date} at {col:loads.origin}. Delivery on {col:loads.delivery_date} at {col:loads.dest}. Commodity: {col:loads.commodity}, {col:loads.weight_kg} kg. Loaded km {col:loads.loaded_km}, empty km {col:loads.deadhead_km}.
Write the arrival and departure time at each stop, keep the stamped shipping document and send the proof of delivery the same day. Report any wait of more than the free hours to the dispatcher.
Our rate is {col:quotes.asking_per_km} per loaded km, a linehaul of {col:quotes.asking_total}. Your offer of {col:quotes.offered_per_km} per km is {col:quotes.gap_pct} below our asking rate.
Waiting time after the free hours, unloading fees paid for you and extra stops are charged extra. The quote is valid for a few days.
We look forward to your answer.
To {col:waiting.customer}, load {col:waiting.load_id}. Our driver {col:waiting.driver} reached the {col:waiting.stop} on {col:waiting.date} and waited {col:waiting.on_site} hours on site.

After {col:waiting.free_hours} free hours the chargeable waiting time is {col:waiting.wait_hours} hours at our hourly charge, a total of {col:waiting.charge}. Already billed on the load: {col:waiting.on_load}.
Please confirm that you will pay the amount of {col:waiting.unbilled} and tell us the person who handles it.
To {col:extras.customer}, load {col:extras.load_id}. This load was cancelled after the truck was sent and we could not use the truck for another load.
Kind of charge: {col:extras.kind}. Amount to pay: {col:extras.amount}. Billed on: {col:extras.billed_on}. Still to bill: {col:extras.unbilled_amt}.
Please confirm the payment or tell us the reason you disagree.

Loaded km {col:loads.loaded_km} and empty km {col:loads.deadhead_km}. Rate {col:loads.rate_per_km} per km, linehaul {col:loads.linehaul}, fuel surcharge {col:loads.fuel_surcharge}, waiting time {col:loads.detention_amount}, unloading fee {col:loads.unloading_fee}. Total {col:loads.total}.

Revenue per loaded km {col:loads.rev_loaded_km}, per km driven {col:loads.rev_driven_km}. Estimated cost {col:loads.est_cost}, estimated profit {col:loads.est_profit}, profit share {col:loads.margin_pct}. Margin check: {col:loads.margin_flag}.
Week starting {col:weekly.week}: {col:weekly.loads} loads, {col:weekly.loaded_km} loaded km and {col:weekly.empty_km} empty km ({col:weekly.empty_share} of all km).
Revenue {col:weekly.revenue}, which is {col:weekly.per_load} per load, {col:weekly.per_km} per loaded km and {col:weekly.per_day} per truck day over {col:weekly.truck_days} truck days.
The four-week average revenue is {col:weekly.avg4}; this week is {col:weekly.vs_avg} against it. Actions for next week are written below.
To {col:appts.customer}, load {col:appts.load_id}. Our {col:appts.stop} appointment at {col:appts.place} on {col:appts.date} has the window {col:appts.window_from} to {col:appts.window_to}.
Our driver {col:appts.driver} cannot keep this window. Please give us a new window on the same day or the next day and confirm it in writing.
We are sorry for the trouble and will keep you informed.
To {col:late.customer}, load {col:late.load_id} on lane {col:late.lane}. The delivery was {col:late.hours_late} hours late.
Cause: {col:late.cause}. We told you about the delay as soon as we knew it. A penalty of {col:late.penalty} was charged, which is {col:late.pen_share} of the load total of {col:late.revenue}.
We ask you to review the penalty in light of the cause above and tell us your decision.

Our average asking rate is {col:qwin.avg_asking} per loaded km and your average offer is {col:qwin.avg_offered}, a gap of {col:qwin.avg_gap}. Fuel surcharge, waiting time and unloading fees are charged as in our schedule.
